== 📋 Initial situation ==
What has to be decided, and why now? Describe the starting point, the trigger and the deadline in a few sentences.

''Example: The current ticket system reaches its license limit at the end of the quarter. We have to decide by 05/31 whether we extend it or switch.''

== 🎯 Decision criteria ==
Name the criteria against which all options are evaluated – this keeps the comparison below fair and comprehensible.

*'''Criterion 1:''' e.g. one-off and running costs
*'''Criterion 2:''' e.g. effort for implementation and training
*'''Criterion 3:''' e.g. data protection and compliance
